besluite.fout: 'as regsgeleerde mense' reads at first as adjective plus noun ('legally learned people'), so a reader stumbles.
besluite.rede: Moving 'mense' before 'as' removes the misreading, keeps the protected word intact and changes nothing about who helped whom.

besluite.fout: 'daar' follows 'daarna' (after prison) and no longer points clearly to the prison.
besluite.rede: Naming the prison restores the intended reference for a Grade 4 reader without adding or moving any fact.
